integrity: The infinite classification is proved by separating terminal sets that meet at least two parts from those contained in one part. A literal brute-force verifier independently reconstructs minimum connected supersets, hence Steiner intervals, for every complete multipartite graph through order 9 and checks the classification, enumerator, and lower/upper consequences.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns ordinary vertex Steiner sets of connected complete multipartite graphs only.
The complete-bipartite scalar Steiner-number formula is prior-covered; the retained claim is the arbitrary-multipartite all-set classification and its enumerative and upper/lower consequences.
The 2002 foundational paper was inspected through its abstract and bibliographic record rather than full text.
The 2017 complete-bipartite full text was inspected and is later than the archive anchor; no arbitrary complete-multipartite all-set theorem was found in the inspected material.
Finite exhaustive verification through order 9 is supplementary evidence and is not used as proof of the infinite theorem.
title: All Steiner sets of complete multipartite graphs
